entries.title: High Beech, Loughton water mains replacement
entries.body: A roughly 19km, three-year mains replacement across more than 60 roads in Loughton. Streets already finished this year: Queens Road, Spareleaze Hill, Hillyfields, Woodbury Hill, Rectory Lane. Streets with work underway or starting around now: Traps Hill (Jun-Dec 2026), Kings Hill (Sep-Nov 2026), Carroll Hill (Sep-Dec 2026), Hillcroft (Oct-Dec 2026). England's Lane and Staples Road are scheduled Aug 2026-Jul 2027.
entries.reverificationNote: Street-by-street dates are from June 2026 MP correspondence, not Thames Water's own live schedule -- confirm against the project page before quoting a specific street/date in a report.

entries.title: Bakers Lane / Cottis Lane, Epping carriageway improvements
entries.body: Multi-phase carriageway reconstruction near Bakers Lane / Cottis Lane, Epping, with signed diversions via St John's Road, Coronation Hill and Lincolns Field. A July 2026 residents' letter put final surfacing around 26 July 2026 (subject to change), but no later update was found -- status as of October 2026 is unconfirmed.
entries.reverificationNote: No update found after the July 2026 residents' letter. Check https://www.essexhighways.org/bakers-lane-epping for the current position before reporting this as open or closed.

sourceNotes.note: Free, OGL-licensed national API for England covering every utility and local-highway-authority road work -- the best candidate for an automated script. Account requested 2026-10-10 (registration takes a few days); build the integration once the key arrives.

Authoritative for Essex, but it's a one.network-powered interactive map (JS-rendered), not a page a script can scrape directly or a feed it can poll -- an API key from one.network (info@one.network) would be needed for automation.

Static per-project pages (already used for High Beech). Reliable for the headline project but its own street-by-street dates lag behind what's actually happening -- cross-check with local press/MP correspondence as done here.

This URL (named in the weekly-ledger workflow prompt and spec-weekly-report.md) now 404s. The council appears to have moved or retired this page -- the workflow's road-closure research step needs a replacement source.

Checked the actual list of roads TfL's road-disruption data covers (api.tfl.gov.uk/Road) -- it's the 23 Transport for London Road Network routes (A1, A2, A3... the North/South Circular, the river crossings), none of which run through or border Epping Forest. Not a usable source for this project; dropped.

sourceNotes.source: TfL Unified API (api.tfl.gov.uk) -- Central line and Weaver line status, bus stop disruptions
sourceNotes.note: Built as scripts/report/tfl_transit_status.py -- no key needed, and confirmed live that an app key changes the rate limit, not the data returned, so this didn't wait for one. Corrects an assumption in the previous evaluation above: Chingford is served by London Overground's "Weaver" line, not Greater Anglia (confirmed via a live stop lookup). Also found a real limit worth recording: the bus stop disruption check (/StopPoint/{ids}/Disruption) 400s past 22 comma-joined stop ids regardless of which ones, so the script batches requests rather than sending every coverage-settlement stop in one call.
